title: Supervisor PXE network configuration
description: Two-interface PXE model required by agent-plan section 2.3. Ansible must refuse to enable dnsmasq when these values are missing or unsafe (overlap with management network, wrong address, or the default-route interface without an explicit override).

management_interface.description: NIC name used for normal admin/SSH access. Must differ from pxe_interface.

pxe_interface.description: Dedicated provisioning NIC or VLAN sub-interface. Must not be the default-route interface unless explicitly overridden.

pxe_subnet.description: CIDR of the isolated PXE network, e.g. 192.0.2.0/24.

pxe_http_url.description: Base URL served by nginx on the PXE interface for iPXE chaining and installer assets.

allow_default_route_interface.description: Explicit override required before pxe_interface may match the host's default-route interface.
